verdict.rationale: Codegen documents cloud agents that run in isolated environments under programmatic control. They can be triggered from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail, and the Python SDK is pitched for 'advanced automation', so autonomous background runs are supported. However, there is no first-class automation builder, recurring schedule, or event-rule configuration; automations appear to be triggered one-off via the API, SDK or mentions. Missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled automations, a built-in automation/trigger configuration UI, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Trigger agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail
Programmatically interact with agents using the Python SDK for advanced automation.
Create and manage AI agents that can write code, fix bugs, and handle development tasks across your repositories with full programmatic control over their execution and monitoring.
Safely run code, install dependencies, and test changes in robust isolated environments
